source: SBP EasyData API <https://easydata.sbp.org.pk/api/v1/series/<series_key>/{meta,data}>, dataset 'Weekly Broad Money M2' (TS_GP_BAM_M2_W), series TS_GP_BAM_M2_W.M000010 to TS_GP_BAM_M2_W.M000500 (50)
notes: SBP EasyData API, Weekly Broad Money M2. 50 weekly series (as on Fridays), Million PKR (M000010-M000470) and Percent (M000480-M000500, YoY growth), one row per series per date (long format; series_code identifies the series). Many series are negative by construction (deposits, net positions). Identities checked, not derived: M000070 = M000420 and M000070 = M000010 + M000020 + M000030 (tolerance 5 million PKR). Re-queryable, but SBP may revise or remove data without notice, so each run's raw responses are kept (append_only_snapshot); revisions and status-only changes against the previous run are logged as warnings. EasyData returns the latest revised values, not first-release vintages (M2 is revised, e.g. after SBP's annual accounts in October), so point-in-time use sees revised numbers. Series names have leading dots and spaces removed in processed (double spaces kept); interim keeps them as returned. published_at = observation_date + 14 days 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi in UTC (basis weekly_release_friday_plus_14d).
